{"metadata":{"description":"A protocol that lets any sufficiently intelligent AI agent join your shared memory by simply reading one file.","id":"gh:1251972531","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"agent-guild","slug":"dqsjqian/agent-guild","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A protocol that lets any sufficiently intelligent AI agent join your shared memory by simply reading"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" that lets any sufficiently intelligent AI agent join your shared memory by simply reading one file."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Agent Guild"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 让多个本地 AI 助手复用同一份偏好、项目约定和工作交接。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | **中文**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Agent Guild 面向**同一用户使用的多个、受信任且能够读写本地文件的 AI 助手**。
